topics.title: The Beginning of Computers
topics.content: People developed calculating tools and machines over time to make arithmetic and information-processing tasks easier. The history of computers includes many inventions that led to modern electronic computers.

topics.title: The Abacus
topics.content: The abacus is an early counting tool that uses beads moved along rods or wires. By moving beads according to place value, a user can represent numbers and perform calculations.

topics.title: Pascaline and Difference Engine
